title: Z--INDE REHAB SECOND BANK BLOCK
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.NATIONAL PARK SERVICE.DOI, NPS CONOPS STRATEGIC
description_text: Critical Acquisition Response Team (CART) - Independence National Historical Park (INDE) - Masonry Rehabilitation of Second Bank Block Amendment 0001 posted 5/19/2026, and extends closing date and time to Friday, June 5, 2026, by no later than 4:00 PM Mountain Time. It also incorporates updated Schedule-SOW-T&Cs, that includes mandatory updates that implement Revolutionary FAR Updates 9, 22 and 23. Full solicitation is now posted as of April 24, 2026 A site visit is being hosted Wednesday, April 29, 2026, see Solicitation - Section L for Specific details and location. Technical Questions are due by close of business on Friday, May 8, 2026
